name: PR findings: severity tally, popover anchor, and the severity filter
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and exercise the FINDINGS feature end to end against seeded data. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner, the severity tally and the FindingCard list are all revealed without an extra click. The seed gives #482 exactly 1 CRITICAL + 2 WARNING + 1 SUGGESTION, which is what makes the tally assertions meaningful: a single finding per level could not tell a real counter apart from a hardcoded '1'. Clicking the Warning filter must leave BOTH warning findings on screen. Locators are unambiguous by construction — the tally pills render uppercase ('2 WARNING'), the filter buttons render title case ('Warning'), and the timeline severity chips render an icon plus a bare number, carrying their words only in aria-label. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
